Mia Chen: Heads-up — noticed a steep drop in active seats for Solara this week, about -48% w/ Monday spike. usage-alert triggered.
Sam Patel: ugh, thanks for flagging. any churn signals or just lower daily activity?
Mia Chen: daily active users down from ~120 -> ~62, avg tokens/day per user down 40%. top routes impacted: /summarize and /qa-batch.
Mia Chen: metric-bot posted the query: ```SELECT date, active_users, tokens FROM customer_metrics WHERE account='solara' AND date >= '2026-02-01' ORDER BY date;```
metric-bot: alert: "usage-drop: solara" severity=medium; recent seat changes: 2 admins removed, api-key rotated.
Jia Gomez: I chatted with our onboarding lead — PO (Diego) left last week, new PM not yet onboarded. sounds like product-contact gap.
Alex Rivera: FYI Solara is in a procurement POC with NimbusAI per last AE update. they started a 2-week trial last Tuesday.
Sam Patel: oh right — NimbusAI could explain the routing shift. do we know which features Nimbus is selling vs our offering?
Alex Rivera: they pitched fine-tuned summarization + integrated retrieval — overlaps with our /summarize + retrieval cache. AE notes: customer demo on 2026-02-16, competitive pilot running.
Mia Chen: putting risk level preliminary = at-risk (high) based on seat drop + stakeholder turnover + competitor pilot.
Jia Gomez: agree. propose re-engage w/ quick enablement workshop for new PM + 1:1 exec check-in.
Sam Patel: + ask for short survey to understand pain w/ current prompts. can we surface any recent quality regressions?
Mia Chen: I ran a recent eval against their frequent prompt set — slight latency jump on dedicated variants after last infra config change (p95 +120ms). not huge but could look like regression.
Mia Chen: snippet of failing cases: ```{"prompt":"summarize invoice items", "score":0.62}```
Alex Rivera: coordinating with AE to pause competitive demo? AE says they can't stop the POC, but we can offer a parallel pilot with ops uplift (dedicated tuning + priority support).
Sam Patel: action items: 1) Mia to schedule enablement workshop w/ new PM (this week). 2) Jia to prepare one-pager comparing our retrieval+summarize vs Nimbus features. 3) Alex to negotiate parallel pilot terms w/ customer. 4) Eng to investigate p95 latency change and report.
Mia Chen: scheduled tentative workshop Thurs 2/19 10am PT. sending calendar invite now.
Jia Gomez: I'll draft the one-pager and share by EOD Wed.
Alex Rivera: I'll ask AE to push for customer exec time and offer a 1-week discounted pilot (ops uplift). copying @Sam for pricing guardrails.
metric-bot: note: renewal window opens 2026-05-01 (90 days).
Sam Patel: thanks — can eng estimate delta for p95 impact and whether it's config or model/quantization?
Mia Chen: pinging eng-sre in the thread, will post logs after they respond.
Mia Chen: quick ask — if we can get the new PM's email and any decision timeline that'd help prioritize.
Alex Rivera: DMing details to Mia now.
Jia Gomez: sharing the one-pager link when it's ready: https://redwood.internal/docs/solara-competitive-brief
Mia Chen: updated risk status: monitoring -> high priority. will run weekly pulse checks and update channel. :eyes:
